fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-03-25, the complainant reported that a silver truck bearing registration number TN-72-YY-1031 parked near Nila Park Industrial Area could not be found the next morning. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-03-23 at about 03:05. Contact details given by the complainant, Padmini Raj, include the number 9000000032. A further person, Nithin Velan, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000004, is stated to be associated with the incident. Padmini Sri (9000000119) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Vijay Raman (mobile 9000000350) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned a vehicle observation and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Truck reportedly taken from an unattended roadside parking area.
fields.Keywords: truck theft, vehicle, mobile number, truck, night, associate, industrial area, suspect
